meta.title: Role-Based Data Restrictions: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Determine whether Role-Based Data Restrictions is available on a Growth-plan tenant.
Use Role-Based Data Restrictions to restrict vendor data, downloads, and deletion by role.
Repeat the same actions on an Enterprise-plan tenant and compare the outcomes.
Switch or verify tenant plan tiers and preserve the same Tenant Admin identity across tenants.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Determine whether Role-Based Data Restrictions is available on a Growth-plan tenant.; Use Role-Based Data Restrictions to restrict vendor data, downloads, and deletion by role.; Repeat the same actions on an Enterprise-plan tenant and compare the outcomes.; Switch or verify tenant plan tiers and preserve the same Tenant Admin identity across tenants.

args.need: sign in as a Tenant Admin on both the Growth-plan and Enterprise-plan tenants, verify and use Role-Based Data Restrictions for vendor data, downloads, and deletion, and compare the refused or absent Growth behavior with the available Enterprise behavior

steps.note: No catalog step can access this capability, change or verify plan tiers, or perform the required role-based restriction comparison.
After the tester completes the comparison, check whether the capability label is visible on the Enterprise tenant's screen.
